classification.difficultyReason: Organise the observations into an ordered stem-and-leaf display, use that ordering to obtain quartiles and check boxplot whiskers, then recognise approximate symmetry from similar spreads on either side.

inlines.text: The speeds of 20 cars measured on a city street were recorded.

answer.worked: Use tens digits as stems and units digits as leaves. Arrange each row's leaves in ascending order, retaining repeated values. The six rows contain $2+3+8+4+2+1=20$ leaves. The completed diagram is shown in the short answer.

answer.short: Box from $18.5$ to $34$, median $26.5$; whiskers at $3$ and $51$. No outliers.
answer.worked:
The ordered data are $3,5,11,14,17,20,24,24,24,26,27,28,29,31,33,35,36,40,42,51$. Split them into two groups of ten.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median}&=\frac{26+27}{2}\\\text{Median}&=26.5\\Q_1&=\frac{17+20}{2}\\Q_1&=18.5\\Q_3&=\frac{33+35}{2}\\Q_3&=34\\\text{IQR}&=34-18.5\\\text{IQR}&=15.5\end{align*}$$

The outlier boundaries are:

$$\begin{align*}Q_1-1.5\text{IQR}&=18.5-1.5(15.5)\\Q_1-1.5\text{IQR}&=-4.75\\Q_3+1.5\text{IQR}&=34+1.5(15.5)\\Q_3+1.5\text{IQR}&=57.25\end{align*}$$

All values lie within these boundaries, so the whiskers reach $3$ and $51$. Draw the box from $18.5$ to $34$ and the median at $26.5$.

children.prompt: Comment on the shape of the distribution of data.

answer.short: Approximately symmetric. There are no outliers.
answer.worked: The median is close to the centre of the box: $26.5-18.5=8$ and $34-26.5=7.5$. The whiskers also have similar lengths: $18.5-3=15.5$ and $51-34=17$. The distribution is approximately symmetric, with no outliers.
